jobs.description:
Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for an Associate to join our skilled and dedicated Valuation team in Copenhagen.

The team

The Valuation team is responsible for financial modelling, valuation framework, applied valuations, and supporting investment decisions through business case reviews with reporting to senior management.

The role

You will be responsible for handling and developing the valuation methodologies applied across CIP funds, working with corporate and regional teams to enhance your financial and valuation skills in a varied portfolio of renewable investments.

As part of the final investment decision process, you will be responsible for engaging with the investment teams, providing detailed financial model assumption reviews to ensure consistent and well-documented business cases, and being accountable for delivering key inputs such as discount rate assumptions to become a trusted business partner, supporting our global investment strategy for the investments and funds managed by CIP.

Furthermore, you will participate in ad hoc analyses on, e.g., power markets, hedging strategy, currency swaps, and other financial products.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

• Develop internal valuation methodologies for new types of investments

• Advising the business on valuation issues and methodologies and maintaining CIP’s valuation framework in collaboration with senior stakeholders

• Participating in various ad hoc financial analyses related to, e.g., financial hedging, benchmarking, factor analysis, mean-variance analysis, risk mitigation, etc.

• Developing and reviewing financial models to ensure consistent implementation of best practices

• Participating in the FID process for new assets by conducting assumption review of underlying business cases

• Preparing and coordinating analysis and communication material for decision-makers at the senior management level

You

The ideal candidate holds a university degree in economics, finance, or a similar field and approximately one year of experience in financial analysis and valuation, with solid skills from private equity firms, top consulting firms, or multinationals, ideally within renewables.

You have a very strong theoretical understanding of complex valuation methodologies and can present complex financial and valuation methods simply and clearly to CIP's senior management.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• The ability to navigate and thrive in a high-intensity environment

• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance analysis and modelling, with the judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills

• Used to working in an international setting

• Fluent in English

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Transaction Banking is changing fast, and the way customers connect with their bank is becoming more sophisticated. Danske Bank is bringing its Customer Implementation and Integration areas together under one unit, and we are looking for a leader who can create a shared direction, build a strong leadership team, and make complex customer journeys simpler and more consistent across five markets.

What you will be doing

You will lead a newly unified organisation spanning Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Lithuania, bringing together experienced leaders, specialist teams and distinct capabilities. Reporting directly to the Head of TxB Sales Enablement, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Product, Technology, IT and Tribe organisations to shape end-to-end customer experiences. Your role sits at the intersection of business, operations and technology, and the decisions you make will shape how corporate customers and financial institutions connect with Danske Bank.

More specifically, you will:

• Set the strategic direction and priorities across all five markets

• Build and develop a leadership team grounded in clarity, empowerment and accountability

• Connect Customer Implementation and Integration to create more seamless customer journeys

• Partner with IT and Tribe teams to shape customer-facing solutions and internal tooling

• Use client insights to inform implementation journeys, integration solutions and commercial priorities

• Encourage the responsible adoption of AI to simplify processes and build employee capabilities

About you

• Solid experience leading organisations through other leaders

• Genuine commitment to developing people, teams and leadership cultures

• Ability to create direction across countries or complex organisational structures

• Skilled at translating strategy into clear priorities and tangible outcomes

• Strong customer and commercial orientation

• Comfortable at the intersection of business, operations and technology

• Able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations

You do not need to come from a traditional banking background. Experience from financial services, consulting, technology, transformation, customer implementation, integrations, APIs, cash management or similar environments is equally relevant and welcome.

What we offer you

This is a rare opportunity to shape a newly formed organisation and leave a lasting mark on how Danske Bank delivers for its customers. You will work in a hybrid model, typically three to four days per week in the office, alongside talented colleagues across multiple markets. We invest in our leaders and offer genuine scope to grow, both in the role and across the wider organisation.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we encourage you to apply. You are also welcome to reach out to Natasha Rajovic, Head of TxB Sales Enablement, at nkuz@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

Location: Aarhus or Copenhagen.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Software Engineer, Digital Assets

Danske Bank's Digital Assets team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong C#/.NET experience. You will build dependable backend services, connect systems and contribute to our technical decisions and engineering practices.

The role

Your work will include designing and developing an orchestration layer linking core banking systems with custody, wallet and blockchain services. Secure APIs, messaging, data handling and reliable transaction processing will be central to the role.

Working closely with the Technical Lead and Product Owner, you will take solutions from design through implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will also collaborate with specialists in architecture, security and operations across the bank.

What you bring

• Proven C# and modern .NET skills, demonstrated through backend software you have delivered and supported in production.

• Good API design and integration skills, covering REST, service authentication and asynchronous communication.

• Experience with relational data modelling and SQL, including transaction handling and query performance.

• Practical knowledge of automated testing, containers, CI/CD and diagnosing services in production.

• The judgement to turn incomplete requirements into testable delivery steps, explain trade-offs, seek feedback and take ownership of your work.

• Clear spoken and written English, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

We encourage continuous learning and thoughtful use of development tools, including AI, alongside sound review and testing habits.

Your day-to-day work

• Develop and maintain C#/.NET backend services with clear interfaces and maintainable code.

• Build the orchestration services connecting core banking systems to external digital-asset platforms.

• Design relational data models and use SQL for consistent, efficient data handling.

• Implement integrations through REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks and messaging, using authentication such as OAuth 2.0 and mutual TLS.

• Build idempotent transaction workflows with clear status tracking, retry behaviour and operational exception handling.

• Work with security specialists to integrate established signing and key-management services, applying least privilege, separation of duties and secure credential handling. Ensure signing operations remain auditable.

• Write unit and integration tests and contribute to peer reviews.

• Help automate builds and releases through CI/CD and containerised deployment.

• Instrument services with logs, metrics and alerts, investigate issues and improve reliability and performance.

• Document design decisions, share knowledge and support colleagues through mentoring.

Useful additional experience

Previous blockchain experience is not required. Any of the following would be an advantage:

• Cloud and delivery: infrastructure as code, container platforms, performance testing, monitoring or recovery planning.

• Wallet and custody connectivity: working with provider APIs, SDKs and webhooks for wallet provisioning, transaction submission and status updates.

• Signing and key protection: hardware security modules (HSMs), multi-party computation (MPC), PKCS#11, key derivation using BIP32 or SLIP-0010, or controls for key lifecycle management, backup and recovery.

• Blockchain transactions: Ethereum or other EVM-compatible networks, ERC-20 transfers, gas and nonce handling, finality or chain reorganisations.

• Banking and payment systems: core-banking integration, SEPA Instant or financial messaging based on ISO 20022.

• Regulated software delivery: familiarity with AML/KYC, the Travel Rule, on-chain screening, MiCA or DORA.

Why join the team

• Influence over solution design, technical choices and engineering practices.

• Hands-on development alongside our Technical Lead, Product Owner and colleagues across the bank.

• The opportunity to deepen your knowledge of digital assets within an established financial institution.

• Scope to share your expertise, mentor others and improve how the team builds, tests and runs software.

Workplace and application

Location: Denmark

Workplace: Hybrid setup, 3 days a week in office.

Relocation: No relocation or visa sponsorship offered

Sounds interesting?

Please submit your motivated application and your CV as soon as possible.

Application deadline is November 11th. Interviews will be helt through-out November

If you have any questions, please reach out to Søren Ørding Olsen sreo@danskebank.dk or Philip Nedergaard Hjulskov phhj@danskebank.dk

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The Opportunity

**The BMC Center of Excellence is seeking an experienced and creative marketing professional to support the development of engaging digital experiences, interactive content and data storytelling initiatives across the global organization.

Working as part of the Center of Excellence and UX team, this role will help global, regional and local marketing teams bring content to life through user-centred design, interactive experiences and compelling visual communications. The successful candidate will have strong design and UX skills, experience using Ceros and Flourish, and a passion for helping audiences engage with complex ideas through intuitive and impactful digital experiences.

This role will work closely with campaign teams, content creators, digital teams and external agencies to support the creation of high-quality content and experiences aligned with EY brand standards and user needs.

**Key Responsibilities

**Interactive Content and Experience Development

• Support the creation of interactive digital experiences using Ceros.

• Develop data visualizations and interactive content using Flourish.

• Translate complex business content, research and insights into engaging visual formats.

• Collaborate with content and campaign teams to enhance storytelling through design and interactivity.

• Recommend appropriate content formats based on audience needs and business objectives.

User Experience and Design Support

• Apply UX and design best practices to improve marketing experiences.

• Develop wireframes, user journeys and simple prototypes to support content development.

• Ensure digital experiences are intuitive, accessible and user-friendly.

• Support usability reviews and testing activities.

• Help maintain design standards, templates and guidance materials.

Center of Excellence Support

• Act as a subject matter resource for Ceros, Flourish and digital experience best practice.

• Support training, enablement and knowledge-sharing activities across BMC.

• Create and maintain reusable assets, templates and playbooks.

• Assist regional and local teams with experience design requests and troubleshooting.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of CoE services and capabilities.

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Work with global marketing teams to deliver digital content and campaign assets.

• Collaborate with content strategists, designers, campaign managers and developers.

• Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

• Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.

Measurement and Optimization

• Monitor performance of interactive assets and experiences.

• Help identify opportunities to improve engagement and usability.

• Support reporting and sharing of best practices and success stories.

**Essential

****Skills and Experience

**

• 
Experience in digital marketing, design, UX, content experience or creative services.

• 
Working knowledge of:

• 
Ceros

• 
Flourish

• 
Figma

• 
Adobe Creative Cloud

• 
Understanding of UX principles and digital design best practices.

• 
Experience creating digital content and visual storytelling assets.

• 
Strong visual communication and presentation skills.

• 
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred

**

• Experience supporting global marketing or communications teams.

• Knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive design.

• Experience with CMS platforms and web publishing.

• Familiarity with AI-enabled creative and content tools.

• Experience within professional services or a matrix organization.

Success Measures

• Increased adoption of Ceros and Flourish across BMC.

• Delivery of high-quality interactive content and digital experiences.

• Positive stakeholder feedback.

• Development of reusable templates and best-practice guidance.

• Improved audience engagement with digital content.

• Contribution to the growth and effectiveness of the Center of Excellence.

Leadership Characteristics

• Creative and curious.

• Audience-focused and detail-oriented.

• Collaborative and service-minded.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced global environment.

• Passionate about design, storytelling and digital innovation.

What we offer you

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

**EY | Building a better working world

**EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

**Build with us

**Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

**Your impact

**This is your chance to build Mollie's presence in Denmark from the ground up, as the first person hired with this market as your sole focus. You won't be starting from zero: you'll have the Nordic foundation already built in Sweden to work from, but the Danish playbook is yours to write.

You'll open the market, land our first Danish customers, and turn early learnings into a repeatable approach we can scale. It's a broader, more entrepreneurial scope than a standard sales role. You'll work deals from $100K a month while building toward bigger opportunities of up to $1 million a month, all while shaping how Mollie understands and enters this market for the long run.

What makes this role stand out is the mix: outbound selling, customer discovery, partnerships, and competitive analysis, all rolled into one seat with real ownership. If you want to build something rather than maintain something, this is that opportunity.

**What You'll Ship

**

• Run outbound sales and manage the full sales process, including around 20 cold calls a week

• Build a Danish pipeline and land Mollie's first customers in the market

• Gather market feedback and grow larger opportunities, including deals of up to $1 million a month

• Build relationships with Danish agencies and work on partnerships alongside the partner manager based in Stockholm

• Share what you learn about the Danish marketing landscape with the marketing team to help shape events and go-to-market plans

• Run competitive analysis to sharpen how Mollie positions itself in Denmark

**What You'll Bring

**

• Around 5 years of full-cycle sales experience, with a strong outbound track record and demonstrated success in structured cold outreach

• Value selling capability, with a data-driven approach to activity and pipeline management

• Strong negotiation and contract handling skills, including experience communicating and negotiating with C-level stakeholders

• Creativity in building a pipeline through partnerships or marketing outreach (you don't need to have done this before, just show the potential)

• Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS sales, built across multiple companies

• Comfortable working hands-on in a role with broad scope and real uncertainty

• Fluency in Danish

**Grow your way

**At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

**AI at Mollie

**We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.occupation: Global Labour Law & Employee Relations Associate - Project Manager
jobs.description:
POCA Business Partnering

People, Organisation & Corporate Affairs****Bagsværd, Denmark

Your impact begins here

Join Global Labour Law & Employee Relations and build your experience at the intersection of Employee Relations, labour law, data analysis and international project management.

In this role, you will help drive key projects across our global Employee Relations agenda, turning complex information and data into insights that support better organisational decisions. Working closely with stakeholders across countries, including our Employee Relations colleagues in the US, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of projects and make a visible impact in an international environment.

What you’ll bring

You are curious, analytical and motivated by understanding how legal considerations, people priorities and business needs come together. You enjoy turning complex information into practical insights and building strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• A master's degree in Law (cand.jur.), Business Law (cand.merc.jur.), or a related field.

• Strong analytical skills and an interest in using data to identify trends and support decision-making.

• An interest in employment law and Employee Relations, and how legal frameworks support business and people outcomes.

• The ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations, presentations and actionable insights.

• Strong project management, communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Confidence working across cultures, geographies and time zones, with the persistence to drive progress and collaboration.

• Professional fluency in English.

It would be an advantage if you have experience from HR, legal, consulting or project-based environments, including internships or student positions, as well as exposure to Employee Relations, employment law, reporting or data analysis.

What you'll do

As Project Manager in Global Labour Law & Employee Relations, you will combine project management, analytical thinking and stakeholder collaboration to support priorities across our global agenda.

Your main responsibilities will be:

• Driving selected projects and workstreams from planning through execution and follow-up.

• Analysing US Employee Relations data and reporting to identify trends, risks and opportunities.

• Translating complex information into clear analyses, presentations and recommendations.

• Collaborating closely with Employee Relations colleagues in the US and other global stakeholders.

• Coordinating activities across countries and functions to ensure alignment and progress.

• Supporting the development of tools, processes, reporting and other Employee Relations initiatives.

You will work closely with experienced Employee Relations and labour law specialists, applying your legal and analytical mindset across a broad range of topics without focusing on traditional legal advisory work.

Who you'll work with

Global Labour Law & Employee Relations is a team focused on supporting Employee Relations and labour law priorities across the organisation. We work closely with colleagues across People & Organisation and the wider business to provide guidance, insights and solutions that help create a strong employee experience while supporting business needs.

As part of the team, you will collaborate with colleagues primarily based in Denmark and the US and gain exposure to different legal frameworks, Employee Relations practices and organisational contexts. The role offers a highly international environment where building relationships, influencing stakeholders and working across geographies are key to success.

Who you can expect here

You will work in an international environment where you can build experience across Employee Relations, labour law, data analysis and project management. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of projects, learn from experienced specialists and work closely with colleagues across countries and functions. Your contribution will help turn complex information into practical insights and support Employee Relations priorities across the organisation.

Who we offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn complex Employee Relations challenges and data into insights that support better organisational decisions, apply for the Global Labour Law & Employee Relations Associate - Project Manager role by November 5th, 2026.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions, please reach out to Rikke Falk Dambo at +45 3448 9119.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Your impact begins here

As GLP QA Professional, you will help make sure non-clinical research at Novo is carried out to Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) standards. You will oversee studies, inspect internal and external work, and turn what you see into clear, practical recommendations that keep research reliable and moving. You will shape how quality is built into non-clinical processes, strengthening the foundation for treatments for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You bring a balanced, practical quality mindset. You work systematically and independently, take initiative and stay flexible when priorities change. To succeed in this role, you have:

• Experience as a laboratory technician and relevant qualification, or a master’s degree in science, pharmacy, medicine or a similar field.

• Experience within GLP, for example from quality assurance, GLP-regulated work, non-clinical research or laboratory activities.

• Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and the ability to interpret and communicate regulatory and procedural requirements.

• Strong analytical and organisational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to work systematically and independently.

• Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build constructive relationships with internal colleagues and external Contract Research Organisations (CROs).

• Proficiency in written and spoken English, and confidence in communicating observations, recommendations and quality matters.

Desirable, but not essential:

Experience from industrial drug development.

What you’ll do

You will be the quality partner for GLP-regulated activities, helping colleagues and CROs meet requirements while keeping study quality and compliance protected.

• Perform quality oversight and compliance verification of GLP-regulated activities, including review of study plans, reports, relevant SOPs and documentation from internal areas and external CROs.

• Plan and conduct study-based and process-based internal inspections, including Good Clinical Laboratory Practice (GCLP) activities where relevant.

• Support stakeholders on GLP requirements and general quality matters, including review of GLP action plans from internal and external audits.

• Contribute to maintaining and improving the department’s QMS, including harmonisation, digitalisation and simplification initiatives.

• Communicate observations, regulatory requirements and practical quality recommendations clearly to internal and external stakeholders, and take part in relevant projects, audits and regulatory inspections.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Non-Clinical Quality, a diverse team of 15 skilled colleagues in Søborg. It is one of two sister departments within Process Management, Non-Clinical, IT & AI Quality, part of R&D Quality. In R&D, curiosity, data, collaboration and operational excellence come together to advance scientific ideas towards clinical testing, and Non-Clinical Quality helps make sure the processes behind that work are fit for purpose.

The team provides QMS expertise to a global organisation and works closely with stakeholders across the value chain. You will have many interfaces: research and laboratory colleagues in internal areas, external CROs and other collaboration partners, and teams across the organisation working on improvement projects.

You will work in an international environment where clear communication helps you build trust, create clarity around requirements and keep work moving. Some travel may be required for audits and other GLP QA activities.

What you can expect here

You will build your GLP expertise and take on increasing responsibility, with room to influence how quality is embedded in non-clinical research processes. Alongside day-to-day oversight, you will contribute to cross-organisational improvement projects and share ideas that improve methods, systems and processes.

You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to work independently and encouraged to make your voice heard. You will grow through practical experience, close collaboration with colleagues and continuous learning.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200.00 to

838,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

Start now

Your impact begins today, so apply by 13 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Senior Data Engineer, you will build the data foundations that bring Supply Chain AI Solutions to life. You will turn complex requirements into scalable, compliant, production-ready data products and pipelines that power strategic AI use cases for the Supply Chain organisation. Working hands-on in Databricks, you will help move ideas into reliable operation, supporting resilient supply chains and the delivery of treatment to millions of people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You bring strong production delivery experience and the ability to lead the data engineering side of an AI use case, from idea to reliable operation.

• 
A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.

• 
At least 8 years of experience in data engineering, including 3+ years in a senior role.

• 
Deep expertise in Azure Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows and Databricks SQL.

• 
Strong proficiency in Python, Apache Spark and SQL, with proven experience designing and building scalable, production-ready data pipelines and data products.

• 
A solid understanding of BI concepts, dimensional modelling, report and semantic layers, data integrations and self-service data platforms.

• 
Hands-on experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, coding best practices and agile ways of working such as Scrum.

• 
Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders and colleagues at different levels of the organisation.

You are technically curious and enjoy building data products that make a real difference. You are structured, take ownership, drive direction and inspire others to keep improving, and you stay on top of the latest trends in data engineering and AI.

Useful, but not essential:

• 
A Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Professional) certification or another relevant data engineering or cloud certification.

• 
Familiarity with Azure and AWS cloud services.

• 
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.

What you’ll do

You will set the critical path for Data Engineering within the delivery team to ensure we deliver reliable, production-ready products for our use cases, while sharing your expertise and support team members in adopting best practices. This includes being a hands-on technical contributor who is comfortable in taking the lead in building the required data products for use case from the early phase all the way to production.

• 
Design and implement data and model pipelines in Databricks, using Unity Catalog for governance and medallion architecture patterns to organise and serve reliable data.

• 
Apply an AI-first engineering mindset to create robust, scalable data foundations that are ready for future AI-driven manufacturing and supply chain use cases.

• 
Work hands-on across the full engineering lifecycle, from data modelling and pipeline development to testing, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.

• 
Build high-quality data products and pipelines within our established Databricks platform and engineering framework, with a focus on performance, cost efficiency, governance, compliance and maintainability

• 
Turn complex requirements into clear engineering priorities, identifying the critical path and making pragmatic decisions about what to solve now, what to simplify and what to develop further over time

• 
Mentor and develop data engineers through design sparring, code reviews and practical coaching.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will spend the majority of your time designing, building and improving solutions, while also providing technical guidance to less experienced engineers. You will work closely with the Lead Data Engineer and other senior technical colleagues, contributing to engineering direction while focusing on turning that direction into high-quality, working solutions.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Enterprise AI within Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, stay close to stakeholders and help deliver trusted technology and high quality. Your team is Supply Chain AI Solutions: a small, end-to-end team where data scientists and engineers work side by side, combining analytical depth with the engineering capability to bring solutions into production.

Your closest colleagues are the Tech Lead, the Lead Data Scientist and the AI Product Owner. You will also collaborate with engineers, architects, data scientists and business stakeholders in the Supply Chain organisation, acting as a senior technical contributor across teams. Together, you will make clear decisions, keep delivery moving and turn practical needs into better operational decisions.

The team is cloud-native, working with platforms such as Databricks, Azure and AWS. It values agility, diverse thinking and continuous learning, and its culture is built on feedback, honesty and fun. The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to take ownership, share your voice and shape how data engineering is built within Supply Chain AI Solutions. You will keep growing through continuous learning and career development, working on AI use cases at the forefront of technology, alongside colleagues who raise the bar with you.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy heree.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn complex data needs into reliable AI-ready products for Supply Chain, apply for the Senior Data Engineer role by November 10th 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions, please reach out to Mikkel Bjerregaard Ditlevsen, MBDV@novonordisk.com.

jobs.occupation: Technical Supporter - Wash and Sterilisation Maintenance Support
jobs.description:
# Your impact begins here

As a Technical Supporter, you will take responsibility for resolving technical challenges and ensuring that equipment within Wash & Sterilisation operates reliably. Working closely with skilled workers and production operators, you will combine daily technical support and troubleshooting with driving change requests, validation activities and improvements. You will work independently, take ownership of your tasks and coordinate solutions across disciplines to support stable production and capacity expansion.

# What you’ll bring

You combine a relevant technical or scientific background with curiosity, ownership and a structured approach to problem-solving. Experience from pharmaceutical or another highly regulated environment is valuable, but we also welcome applications from newly graduated candidates.

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant technical or scientific field, such as mechanical engineering, marine engineering, automation engineering or similar.

• The ability to communicate fluently in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing.

• Knowledge of optimising automated processes and a structured approach to solving technical problems, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Preferably, experience with aseptic production and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), or experience from another highly regulated environment.

• Knowledge of and hands-on experience with SAP, programmable logic controllers (PLC) and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems is an advantage.

• A responsible and goal-oriented working style, with the willingness to take the technical lead, challenge existing solutions constructively and follow tasks through to completion. You can manage deadlines, maintain an overview and coordinate activities across professional disciplines.

# What you’ll do

• Take responsibility for ensuring that equipment within Wash & Sterilisation operates as required and supports reliable production.

• Provide and coordinate daily technical support for skilled workers and production operators, working closely with them to resolve equipment and process issues.

• Troubleshoot equipment and process issues, including during shutdowns and breakdowns, and drive systematic problem-solving with relevant colleagues.

• Support capacity expansion and contribute to systematic technical problem-solving.

• Create and drive change requests and validation activities, and implement technical improvements from problem identification through to completion.

• Communicate daily with stakeholders across the organisation, coordinate technical activities and follow up on agreed actions while managing several tasks and priorities.

# Who you’ll work with

You will join the Formulation, Wash & Sterilisation area within Drug Product Manufacturing in Kalundborg. The area supplies washed and sterilised equipment for the subsequent production steps. The team consists of 14 colleagues: 8 skilled workers responsible for equipment maintenance in Formulation and Wash & Sterilisation and 6 technical supporters providing daily support to skilled workers and production operators, as well as working with equipment and process validation.

You will work across disciplines with operators, skilled workers, technical supporters and colleagues in other departments. The environment is busy and collaborative, with an emphasis on trust, mutual respect and solving technical challenges together.

# What you can expect here

You can expect significant individual responsibility and the opportunity to take the lead on technical tasks while drawing on the knowledge of your colleagues. Your work will combine troubleshooting and daily production support with validation, capacity expansion and improvements. You will develop your understanding of equipment and processes in a regulated production environment and see how your solutions contribute to reliable production.

# What we offer

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 499,600 to 734,400 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

# Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to take responsibility for technical support, troubleshooting and continuous improvements within Formulation, Wash & Sterilisation, apply for the Technical Supporter, Formulation, Wash & Sterilisation Maintenance Support role in Kalundborg by 8th of November 2026.

For further information, please contact Dan Engelhardt at DEHD@novonordisk.com

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application. Instead, please include a few sentences in your CV about why you are applying. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Role - Advanced IT System Management Professional

Location - Hilleroed

Contract: Temporary position – 1-year fixed-term contract.

Your impact begins here

As Advanced IT System Management Professional, you will keep the IT Systems and Computerized Equipment behind Materials & Device Analytics QC reliable, compliant and fit for purpose. Over one year, you will drive continuous improvement, keep compliance documentation current and give laboratory users a clear point of contact. Your work helps ensure our global production sites have the materials they need to operate efficiently and meet patient demand.

What you’ll bring

• A bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline.

• A minimum of 3 years’ experience in IT System or Computerized Equipment management.

• A structured, detail-oriented approach and a clear focus on quality.

• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset, strong communication skills and a collaborative way of supporting colleagues.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Useful, but not essential:

Experience from the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated industry.

What you’ll do

You will hold a key role in IT governance and compliance for a portfolio of IT Systems and Computerized Equipment within Materials & Device Analytics QC, driving continuous improvement as you go.

• Support life cycle management and contribute to smaller projects, so IT Systems and Computerized Equipment remain compliant with all applicable requirements.

• Maintain compliance documentation and standard operating procedures (SOPs), keeping them accurate, up to date and easy to access.

• Act as a technical resource in implementation projects and share your knowledge across the team.

• Align and manage stakeholder and user expectations for IT Systems and Computerized Equipment.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for local users, Project Managers, Validation Managers, System Owners and Quality Assurance (QA).

Who you’ll work with

You will join Sourcing LABS IT, part of Computerised Laboratory Systems in the Laboratory, Planning & Eco-systems area. We are the IT and systems partner for the Materials & Device Analytics QC laboratories and GMP Materials Analytical Science & Technology. Together, these areas cover raw materials, devices, primary and printed packaging, specifications and quality control prior to production release.

You will be part of a team of nine colleagues in Denmark, supported by three Compliance Supporters in Brazil, so close cross-border collaboration is part of everyday work. Your closest partners will be local users, Project Managers, Validation Managers, System Owners and QA. The position is based in Hillerød, Denmark. You will have broad ownership and the opportunity to influence how laboratory technologies are implemented and used across multiple sites.

What you can expect here

You will join a collaborative team that values expertise and invests in professional development. You will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and grow your skills through hands-on project work and knowledge sharing with colleagues in Denmark and Brazil.

This is a 1-year fixed-term position.

As a Consulting Solution Architect for the Data Management domain, you will serve as a trusted advisor throughout consulting engagements — helping clients shape feasible solution options, leading or supporting the design of custom, high‑value solutions, and ensuring strong domain integrity aligned with the broader SimCorp One solution design. You will play a central role in supporting scalable, high‑quality custom implementations and contribute to consistency and excellence across our Consulting organization.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Consulting, Product Management, and Value Streams to ensure our custom solutions remain both feasible and aligned to SimCorp standards. You will also help advance our practices, strengthen our knowledge base, and mentor the next generation of solutioning talent within SimCorp.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As SimCorp embarks on the SimCorp One journey, the Consulting Solution Architect plays a critical role in enabling the Consulting organization to deliver high‑quality, scalable custom solutions. Consulting Solution Architects ensure that custom client requirements are shaped and delivered with strong domain integrity, consistency, and alignment with SimCorp’s delivery methodologies (Compass) and the SimCorp One solution.

You will:

• Influence key architectural decisions in strategic and complex consulting projects

• Strengthen our consulting methodologies and enablement efforts

• Contribute to the evolution of consulting solution best practices and patterns

Our new Consulting Solution Architects bring deep domain experience within the scope of the Data Management Sub-Service Line and the consulting skills needed to act as trusted advisors to internal and external clients.

This is a global position, with potential locations across SimCorp offices worldwide. International travel may be required based on client needs. The role reports to the Global Practice Lead.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

****Global Practice Ownership

**

• Own the Global consulting practice within your domain. This includes ownership of the global consulting artifacts for your domain.

• Contribute with structured feedback into standards evolution.

• Shape and define our consulting practice within your domain.

• Support the enablement of consultants to deliver custom client solutions with high quality, consistency, and aligned with the SimCorp One solution.

**Scoping & Advisory

**

• Lead or support domain‑specific consulting scoping during sales and early project phases for complex and strategic consulting engagements

• Act as the key advisor for solution options and custom feasibility

• Collaborate with Sales, Engagement Leads, Product Management, and Value Streams

• Define and validate custom architecture and design in complex and strategic client projects

• Ensure custom build quality and provide ongoing design assurance

• Resolve domain-specific challenges in collaboration with consulting, value streams, and product teams

**Knowledge Enablement

**

• Document and disseminate domain knowledge and best practices

• Support onboarding and capability building within Consulting

• Collaborate on cross‑functional learning initiatives

**Collaboration & Influence

**

• Work closely with Product Management, Value Streams, and project teams

• Represent your domain in discussions on solution direction and domain challenges

• Interface with clients, including senior stakeholders, on custom solution matters

**Mentoring & Community Leadership

**

• Coach consultants and aspiring architects

• Help grow solutioning maturity within Consulting

• Influence cross‑domain architecture discussions and knowledge sharing

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to excel at several of the following skills and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.

• Relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a relevant Business degree

• At least 7+ years of proven experience designing and implementing SimCorp Dimension solutions

• Deep business knowledge within the Data Management domain. Experience with the SimCorp Data Management Core solution and the SimCorp Data Management Service is a plus.

• Understanding of our clients’ general business processes and operating model

• International experience and global mindset

• Have been involved in several SimCorp Dimension implementations from the early stages of the project

• Ability to build relationships, drive discussions and impact stakeholders when required

• Engagement in partnering with various parts of the SimCorp organization

• Proactiveness, creativeness and commercial mindedness with a global perspective

• Proficiency in English

**Benefits

**SimCorp offers several benefits that might play a significant factor in considering whether to accept a job offer. Since SimCorp operates in 30+ offices worldwide, the benefits package may vary from country to country.

Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please click below to apply. For further information about the position, please contact Kasper Bøgh Larsen, Global Practice Lead Data and Post Trade or Hanna Brzózka, Lead Talent Acquisition Partner at hanna.brzozka@simcorp.com to learn more about the vacancy, recruitment process or SimCorp internal transfer policy.

**Please note that only applications sent through our Workday system will be processed.

**In addition to submitting your CV please add a short Cover Letter motivating your interest elaborating on:

• What is your vision for yourself as a Solution Architect?

• What do you hope to accomplish?

• How will you work together with the GPL and other Solution Architects to advance both your and SimCorp’s visions?

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

__________

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

What you’ll bring

You are an experienced project leader who is comfortable in senior discussions, structures complexity quickly and brings others with you. You will have:

• A minimum of 8 years’ relevant experience.

• Demonstrated experience with consulting toolbox, frameworks and approaches and with working with stakeholders on all levels.

• Experience in large, global technology implementation projects where you have brought the solutions end-to-end to your business stakeholders.

Useful, but not essential:

jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Associate Director, Strategic Scientific Relations & Engagement Excellence, you will be responsible for leading the orchestration of impactful, coherent and high-value relationships across Medical Associations, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), emerging thought leaders, and other scientific stakeholders. You will define the frameworks that help Global, Regions and Affiliates engage the right experts at the right time, consistently and in line with compliance. Besides, you will be responsible for the KOL engagement framework, ensuring the identification of current and emerging KOLs and driving our engagement planning process across the organization, while continuously pushing the digitalization agenda forward.Your work strengthens the scientific partnerships that support progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

• A Bachelor’s degree with relevant experience, or a Master’s degree or above, in a relevant area.

• 7+ years in Medical Affairs and/or external scientific engagement.

• 7+ years of project management experience.

• A proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and the organisational change needed to drive adoption of new processes, frameworks and digital tools in a complex matrix organisation.

• Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across functions, geographies and organisational levels.

• A practical understanding of pharmaceutical compliance for interactions with healthcare professionals.

Nice to have but not essential:

• Experience with AI-enabled or digital approaches to stakeholder mapping, insight synthesis or engagement coordination. Experience using engagement data, analytics and digital tools to guide decisions

• and prioritise stakeholders.

What you’ll do

This is a subject matter expert role with no people management responsibility. You will set direction, work independently and make decisions that shape how scientific relationships are built across Novo.

• Define the overarching Strategic Scientific Relations strategy and framework for medical associations, KOLs and other scientific stakeholders.

• Drive a centralised, systematic approach that keeps stakeholder engagement prioritised and coherent across Global, Regions and Affiliates.

• Set the global strategy and framework for compliant, insight-led KOL engagement across therapy areas, with a coordinated and transparent approach to identifying and engaging KOLs.

• Lead the Individual Engagement Planning process and connect it to medical association plans, congress activity and emerging scientific leader priorities.

• Develop and implement approaches to identify, engage and build relationships with emerging scientific leaders and future influencers.

• Drive the evolution of digital tools, data management and responsible AI-enabled approaches that improve stakeholder identification, engagement planning and transparency.

Who you’ll work with

You will be part of the MAP & KOL Engagement team within Strategic Scientific Communication, part of Global Medical Affairs. In Product & Portfolio Strategy, colleagues connect commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across therapy areas, helping guide the Novo portfolio and strengthen competitiveness.

You will partner closely with therapeutic area medical teams, congress and medical education colleagues, and regional and affiliate medical teams. You will also work with Clinical Development, Commercial, Legal and Compliance. Together, you will turn a shared framework into clear, consistent engagement that works from global to local level.

What you can expect here

You will have room to shape strategy, build new frameworks and contribute to broader Global Medical Affairs priorities. You will be trusted to take initiative, make decisions and bring strategic oversight to work that matters across Novo. You will join an environment that values diverse perspectives and a shared focus on real progress, with continuous learning and career development.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 y 1,245,100.00 DKK DKK. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on your skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term incentives  as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Clinical data has the greatest value when it is reliable, accessible and ready to support the decisions that matter. As a Clinical Data Management Specialist, you will lead end-to-end data management for global clinical trials, helping ensure high-quality data from protocol development through submission.

You will combine hands-on trial leadership with strategic thinking, bringing functions and partners together to manage complexity, strengthen data quality and develop better ways of working.

What you'll bring

You are a proactive and collaborative clinical data management professional who can turn complex requirements into clear priorities and high-quality delivery.

To succeed in this role, you will bring:

• A BSc or MSc in IT, Natural Sciences, Life Sciences or an equivalent field

• At least 3 years of experience within clinical data management or an equivalent area

• Experience leading trials or projects in an international environment with increasing complexity

• Strong project management and stakeholder management skills

• A good understanding of data management processes, clinical data flow, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and regulatory requirements

• Fluency in written and spoken English

You bring analytical rigour, accountability and sound judgement to your work. You are also comfortable challenging established ways of working and contributing to innovative solutions or new methodologies.

What you'll do

You will take ownership of clinical data management activities across the trial lifecycle. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead data management planning, timelines and priorities, aligning deliverables with overall trial goals

• Develop and maintain data management plans and other key trial documentation

• Shape effective trial design by providing data management input to protocols and defining data collection requirements and risks

• Drive data quality and integrity while coordinating risks and issues with relevant stakeholders

• Support submission deliverables, data access processes, regulatory compliance, and trial-level audit and inspection readiness

• Partner with the Project Clinical Data Manager on project-level alignment, inspection readiness and vendor assessments within your area of expertise

Who you'll work with

You will join Clinical Data Management within Clinical Data Management & Programming, a global organisation responsible for the planning, execution, quality and delivery of clinical trial data across Novo Nordisk's development portfolio.

Your work will connect you with Project Clinical Data Managers, project leadership, cross-functional colleagues and external partners. Together, you will manage data from protocol development through database lock and regulatory submission, while contributing to cross-trial alignment and effective data strategies.

What you can expect here

You will have the opportunity to work with global clinical trial portfolios where your expertise can directly shape how complex clinical data is planned, collected and delivered. You will be able to contribute ideas, challenge existing approaches and help develop better ways of working while collaborating across functions and geographies.

Start now

Your impact begins here

As Global Advanced Analytics Lead, you will apply statistical modelling and machine learning to commercial questions that matter for Novo’s portfolio and launches. You will turn commercial and real-world data into insights that help teams understand market and patient dynamics and assess commercial opportunities. The role combines hands-on analytical work with direct business engagement. You will take ownership of analytical projects, from shaping the question and building the model to explaining what the findings mean for the decision ahead.

As Novo strengthens its core business and builds future growth opportunities, understanding changing patient needs, consumer behaviour and market dynamics is increasingly important. Your work will support Product & Portfolio Strategy in sharpening global strategies, strengthening portfolio competitiveness and preparing for successful launches.

What you’ll bring

You bring hands-on analytical skill and the judgement to turn it into decisions people can act on.

• A master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Business Administration or a related field, with strong quantitative and applied analytics expertise.

• 5+ years in advanced analytics, applied data science or statistical modelling, including hands-on delivery of analytical projects.

• Strong practical capability in Python or R, and in SQL for data extraction and preparation.

• Experience building and validating statistical and machine learning models, and assessing their performance, uncertainty and limitations.

• Experience with complex datasets, reproducible code, version control and technical documentation.

• The ability to translate findings into business recommendations and explain them clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

• Structured problem-solving, openness about uncertainty and limitations, and sound judgement on when to seek guidance or escalate.

Useful, but not essential:

• A PhD or a strong research background.

• Pharmaceutical commercial analytics or healthcare real-world data experience, particularly segmentation and launch uptake modelling.

What you’ll do

You will own the hands-on delivery of advanced analytics projects that inform portfolio and commercial decisions. Your responsibilities will include:

• Translate business questions into analytical approaches, working with stakeholders to clarify the decision, scope and intended outcomes.

• Develop and refine predictive models, patient segmentation models and launch uptake analyses to understand commercial opportunities and changing market dynamics.

• Investigate complex commercial and real-world datasets, applying statistical and machine learning methods suited to the question.

• Translate findings into clear recommendations, explaining their commercial implications and discussing them directly with stakeholders.

• Build reliable, reproducible analyses, validating model performance and making assumptions, uncertainty and data limitations clear.

• Collaborate with BI, Data Governance and enterprise technical partners to ensure analytical outputs can be maintained and used effectively.

• Propose new analytical questions, share reusable code and contribute practical improvements to the team’s methods.

The role is base in Søborg, Denmark.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Data, Analytics & AI Strategy team within Product & Portfolio Strategy (PPS). PPS brings together commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across therapy areas to guide Novo’s portfolio and strengthen its competitiveness.

Your projects will connect you with colleagues across Portfolio Strategy, Insights & Access, Commercial Units, Global Medical Affairs and Business Development, depending on the business question. You will also collaborate with R&D, US and International Operations, Enterprise IT and technical partners.

You will work closely with the Advanced Analytics Associate Director on analytical design, methodological choices and interpretation of findings. You will own hands-on delivery of your projects, with the Associate Director providing technical direction, challenge and review. This partnership combines independent analytical ownership with close technical collaboration.

What you can expect here

You will work on technically challenging questions with clear commercial relevance, combining hands-on modelling with direct collaboration across the global business. The role offers ownership of analytical delivery, close partnership with experienced colleagues and the opportunity to see your findings inform portfolio and launch decisions.
